info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Biotite Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Biotite Produce Detail Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage detailed information about biotite products in their catalog. This API allows users to add new detail entries related to biotite produce, facilitating better organization and retrieval of product specifications. Typical consumers include inventory managers and sales teams who require up-to-date product details for better decision-making and customer interactions. Through this API, companies can enhance their product offerings and improve overall customer satisfaction.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details related to biotite production. It accepts specific data related to the biotite produce and processes it accordingly to store the information in the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to submit details regarding the biotite production process. It expects a JSON formatted object that contains all necessary attributes required for the operation. Ensure that the provided data adheres to the defined schema to avoid validation errors.

200.description: Request completed successfully with a detailed response.

CreateCatalogBiotiteProduceDetailRequest.title: Biotite Produce Request Body

biotite_produce_id.description: The unique identifier for the biotite produce.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity requesting the biotite produce.

quantity.description: The quantity of biotite produce requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is of high priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the biotite produce.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the biotite produce.

CreateCatalogBiotiteProduceDetailRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for creating a biotite produce order. It contains details about the order such as the producer's ID, quantity requested, pricing, and dimensions.

Dimensions.title: Dimensions

width.description: The width of the biotite produce.

height.description: The height of the biotite produce.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the dimensions, e.g., centimeters, inches.

Dimensions.description: This schema represents the dimensions of the biotite produce including width, height, and unit.

CreateCatalogBiotiteProduceDetailRespons.description: Response schema for the Biotite produce details operation, providing the status of the operation, record identification, processing time, matched count, and pricing details.
